name: Maximilian Gruber
bio:
Maximilian's journey into motorsport catering began unexpectedly. While studying culinary arts in Vienna, he took a summer job assisting a catering company that served a local racing team. The high-energy environment and the dedication of the team captivated him. He quickly realized that he wanted to combine his passion for food with the thrill of racing.

Over the years, Maximilian honed his skills by working at various motorsport events, from Formula 3 races to endurance championships. He prides himself on crafting menus that cater to the specific dietary needs and preferences of the team, ensuring that everyone is fueled and focused. His attention to detail, coupled with his ability to adapt to changing circumstances, makes him an invaluable asset to Rahal Letterman Lanigan. Maximilian believes that a well-fed team is a winning team, and he is dedicated to providing the best possible culinary experience.

What truly sets Maximilian apart is his talent for incorporating regional specialties into his menus. He sources fresh, local ingredients whenever possible, creating dishes that reflect the culture of the race location. This not only enhances the team's dining experience but also fosters a sense of connection to the local community.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Maximilian is of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting his active lifestyle.

quirks: Insists on using only Austrian-made coffee filters.
Always has a small notebook filled with recipe ideas inspired by race locations.
Whistles classical music while prepping ingredients, much to the amusement of the crew.
